capabilities: > Sync Lark Wiki spaces into Obsidian vault
> Convert Lark markdown to GFM tables
problem: Manually keeping notes consistent between a dedicated wiki platform (Lark) and a local knowledge base (Obsidian) is time-consuming and error-prone.

relations.evidence: Uses lark-cli as the transport so auth, scopes, and API coverage are handled upstream

summary: A two-way synchronization tool that mirrors content between an Obsidian vault and a Lark Wiki space using the lark-cli.
